تقايضت (form VI)
# تَقَايَضْتُ (taqāyaḍtu) /ta.qaː.jadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# تَقَايَضْتَ (taqāyaḍta) /ta.qaː.jadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# تَقَايَضْتِ (taqāyaḍti) /ta.qaː.jadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# تَقَايَضَتْ (taqāyaḍat) /ta.qaː.ja.dˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
